headline: G7 allies scramble to put Ukraine back atop Trump's agenda as war drags on
context: U.S. allies at the Group of Seven summit are pushing the war in Ukraine back on President Donald Trump's agenda. The Iran conflict has recently overshadowed the war in Ukraine.

sources.name: NPR
